discussion_comments.comment_body:
Instead of defining that all these methods return `Chalk`, you can also say that they return `this`.

```js
rgb(r: number, g: number, b: number): this;
```

That's also what TS generates for the type definitions. Just another approach though.
I think it could just be `export const chalkStderr: typeof chalk;`

Is it possible to define this as just an re-export of the [`supports-color`](https://github.com/chalk/supports-color) package? I guess this could be useful if users wants to Cmd+click to view source definition or something.

Go to definition always brings you to the type definition file and not the actual implementation so I don't know how helpful it is.
But it would be possible to create a definition for `supports-color` and add it as a dependency.
